title: Code and data for: Ridge-to-reef sediment management under uncertainty: a Bayesian belief network approach
description: The Bayesian belief network model file (GeNIe 2.0), final ARIES model rasters (baseline and 12 management alternatives), subwatershed and land-tenure layers, and the Python and R code for Oleson et al., 'Ridge-to-reef sediment management under uncertainty: a Bayesian belief network approach' (submitted to Environmental Management). Version 1.1.0 adds the final-run rasters and code that regenerates Figures 4-7 and S1-S3, the Table 2 cost-effectiveness values and Tables S3, S5 and S6 from them (run_all.sh). Version 1.0.0 files built from the earlier results workbook are retained. See README.md.
